The '''Kaensada Hills''' are a location on the [[Seanchan (continent)|Seanchan continent]].

The Kaensada Hills were brought into the [[Seanchan]] empire circa {{ne|700}}. Even after three hundred years, the local tribesmen are only half civilized.{{ref/book|10|4}}
